'''Xi Char''' was a fanatic polytheistic religious order of the [[Xi Charrian/Legends|Xi Charrians]] that devoted itself to high-precision manufacturing. To that end, they founded the [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]] company. They were led by a [[Prelate/Legends|Prelate]]. They thought that all life was a shadow of the paradise of the afterlife, believing that creating machines was a way to glimpse the afterlife.

Hard work was the same as prayer to them; when a member of the faith became injured, he voluntarily exiled himself so that no others would witness his imperfection. Xi Char factories doubled as religious cathedrals. Their motto was ''"The deity is in the details."''

In [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]], [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] infiltrated the Xi Char, stealing valuable information from them while posing as a convert to the order. When he was exposed for what he truly was, the Xi Char twice attempted to assassinate him, their second attempt in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]] resulting in the death of his father, [[Narro Sienar|Narro]]. Because of his actions, the Xi Char refused to take any more [[Human/Legends|Human]] apprentices, fearing betrayal.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Xi Char assisted two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], in tracking down the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] by pointing them to one of their number who had helped construct [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechno-chair]].
